title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass, Freestanding | Fire Engine Red | Carolina | Allied Brass

This freestanding paper towel holder stand keeps the roll upright for space-saving storage and a steady pull when you tear off sheets in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional kitchens hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.
